title: Norton Museum Video
content: Glenn Tomlinson of the Norton Museum of Art introduces the Dinotopia exhibition in this video.Norton Museum websiteFor potential museum venues inquiring about possibly hosting the Dinotopia show, please contact Mary Melius at the Norman Rockwell Museum at mmelius (at) nrm.orgBTW, anyone know how I can keep from clipping the right side of the videos when they post?
